summary: Compressed discussion snapshot: operator incidents and vendor changes (Anthropic, Meta), rising agent infra (memory/MCP/orchestration), and several operator reports about agent safety and defaults. | Vendor announcements: Anthropic Opus 5 release, AWS Bedrock AgentCore GovCloud expansion, Vercel AI Gateway sandbox integrations; operator guidance from JetBrains and Google; infra updates from Cloudflare and Modal. | GitHub OSS snapshot: vendor releases (Microsoft, Dify, Vercel, Mem0), plus rising infra primitives for sandboxes, memory, token compression, and observability. Missing social/operator field reports for real-world workflows. | Packages shard shows strong vendor agent clients (OpenAI, GitHub), container/runtime infra (Amazon ECS), rising MCP/sandbox SDKs and an emergent agent-security toolset. No social/operator field reports in this shard — gap for user_workflow signals.
